implementation.targetScope: Conditional class strings, nested arrays/dictionaries, custom stringification, CSS module binding and deduplication. CommonJS and ESM; no UMD global.

source: Written from public documentation, declaration signatures and black-box behavior. No upstream runtime source read or copied. Bounded traversal follows our owned vclsx design; no external runtime dependency.
differences: Null-prototype dictionaries and non-callable toString fields are supported safely.
CSS-module mappings consult own properties only, avoiding inherited prototype names.
Deep arrays use explicit frames; cycles throw TypeError. Shared arrays remain valid.

caller.scope: Documentation-page caller, not a claim about contest-page traffic or application adoption.

optimization: Separate default/bound hot loops, cached unshadowable own-property intrinsic, reusable dedupe collector and direct result assembly. Unseparated class strings avoid regex splitting. Deep traversal and all dictionary safety rules remain; active arrays can shrink without trapping traversal.
